notes.title: Notice of Patch Update (10379677)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support on DORAEMON STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of the Great Kingdom.

A patch update has been released.

Patch Release Date: 9th Mar 2023
-----------------

The following items have been distributed for free.
- Noby Balloon
- Doraemon Balloon
- Summer Wear Set
- Home Furniture Set (Red Paper Lantern, Retro Silver Table, Wicker Chair)
Fixed error where during 2-Player mode, the "Land Fishing Rod" is activated for Player 2 when used by Player 1.

-----------------
Please note that an internet connection is required to apply the update.

notes.title: Notice of Patch Update (10055053)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support on DORAEMON STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of the Great Kingdom.
A patch update has been released.

Patch Release Date: 18th Jan 2023

-----------------

Fixed certain text.
Fixed issue where the "Walk" input key is unexpectedly reverted, after restarting the game.
Adjusted interaction range of certain objects, due to issues while attempting to talk to Non-player Characters near certain objects.
Adjusted the increase in friendship level with Foira under certain conditions.
Adjusted probabilities in changes of weather.
- Mid-Spring to Late-Spring: Higher probability of rain.
- Early-Summer: Higher probability of rain.
- Early-Autumn, Late-Autumn: Higher probability of cloud.
- Mid-Winter to Late-Winter: Higher probability of snow.
Pushing and rotation of animals are now faster.
Adjusted probability of certain crops appearing.
▼Increased probability
- Ginger
- Royal Fern
- Mugwort
▼Adjusted probability at Hissfizzle Pass
- Mugwort (Will appear at Hissfizzle Pass as well)
- Dandelion (Reduced probability)
Fixed issue where the crown mark is not displayed on caught fish and insects under specific conditions.

Improved usability and overall game stability.-----------------

Please note that an internet connection is required to apply the update.

notes.title: Notice of Patch Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support on DORAEMON STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of the Great Kingdom.
A patch update has been released.

Patch Release Date: 2nd November 2022

-----------------

Fixed the issue where characters with the effects of “Come-Here Chow” cannot be set as a Buddy.
Fixed the issue where items are not shipped from the Ship Crate, when 18:00 is elapsed during an Event.
Fixed the issue where pets and animals disappear under certain circumstances.
The Help pages can now be navigated by directional buttons. Please note that the Help pages during tutorial events are excluded from this change.
The stamina used up is reduced from 4 to 3, when using the Super Hoe and Super Watering Can with max power.
The reward for the following To-Do List Request is changed as follows.
“Stuffed Animal Clothes”
Reward: 1300 → 1650
Adjusted the affection level increased when letting an Otter out.
Navigation from Sunswept Hill to Chitterchirp Woods is possible now from the wheat field at the back of the map.
Fixed the issue of unintentional movements to other locations under certain inputs.
Fixed the issue where an item is unregistered from Favorites, when moved to another item slot.
Fixed the issue where the effects of the Invisible Cape and Unturned Stone Cap are not reflected to Player 2 during Offline 2-player multiplayer.
Added the function to have dinner at home.
Examine Noby’s seat in the living room between 19:00 and 20:00 to trigger the event. Eating dinner restores the player’s stamina. The time will be 20:00 after the dinner event.
Items are now rearrangeable in the Fridge while selecting Materials for cooking.
Fixed the issue where the remaining effective time of a Charm expires after certain Events, regardless of the remaining time.
Adjusted the number of materials needed for the Invention Inventor.
Adjusted the number of items obtained while purchasing certain animals for the first time.
Cow, Sheep, Alpca: Fodder 3 → 10
Chicken: Chicken Feed 3 → 5
Fixed the issue where items disappear when the following actions are carried out.
[olist]
Divvying up when picking up item
Exchanging with an item with an item count of 99
Exchanging with a different item
Pressing “Cancel”[/olist]
Adjusted the price of food at the diner due to game balance issues. The adjusted prices are as follows.

Baked Yam				100→80
Cherry Tart				290→120
Clafoutis					410→220
Lemon Tart				410→120

Mushroom Pasta			290→200
Grilled Fish				110→90
Grilled Seafood			920→360
Yuzu Muffin				110→240
Persimmon Pudding			160→200
Pescatore					210→500
Longtooth Stew			160→720
Mayonnaise				200→300
Egg						100→200
Milk						150→250
Cacao					80→200
Strawberry				380→550
Almond					80→180
Apple					160→180
Pasta					150→300
Ketchup					200→700
Fixed issue where characters, animals, items, etc. enter an unintended state when starting or ending an event under certain conditions.
Resolved the phenomenon of certain events not being played properly.

Adjusted certain sound effects.
Adjusted certain text.
Improved usability and overall game stability.

-----------------
Please note that an internet connection is required to apply the update.
